title: Energy is vital to a well-functioning water sector
book_use: Chapter 17 evidence on global desalination scale, regional concentration, and the projected growth of desalination energy demand
notes: IEA reports about 21,000 desalination plants operating in roughly 150 countries, around half of installed capacity in the Middle East and North Africa, and global desalination energy demand nearly doubling since 2010 with another doubling to 2030 under current trends. Treat the 2030 result as a scenario direction, not an observed outcome; desalination can relax freshwater scarcity but does not remove capital, intake, brine-disposal, grid, geography, or allocation constraints.
